fts_xapian_db_path.description: Base directory where per-user Xapian databases are stored. May include `%u` (username) or `%d` (domain) placeholders.

fts_xapian_autoindex.description: Whether to automatically index new or updated messages in the background.

fts_xapian_max_index_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a message to index. Messages larger than this are skipped. Set to 0 to disable size limit.

fts_xapian_workers.description: Number of background indexer worker threads. Set to 0 to disable background indexing (all indexing is synchronous).

fts_xapian_fast.description: Enable fast (but less accurate) tokenization. Recommended only for high-throughput systems where speed trumps precision.

fts_xapian_stemming_languages.description: List of languages to enable stemming for (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de'). Stemming improves recall by matching word roots.

items.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code for stemming (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'pt').

fts_xapian_db_flags.description: Xapian database creation flags to adjust behavior (e.g., 'compact' for space savings, 'small' for low-memory systems).

fts_xapian_exclude_mailboxes.description: Mailbox patterns (glob-style) to skip during indexing. Useful to exclude Drafts, Sent Items, or junk folders.

items.description: Mailbox name pattern (supports '*' and '?' wildcards) to exclude from indexing (e.g., 'Trash/*', 'Junk*').
